name: Present for You ~Watashi o A-Ge-Ru~
original_name: Present for you ～わたしをあ・げ・る～
source: Mom: "To tell you the truth, Shun-chan, I have a present for you. That surprise present is... an "Onee-chan"! She will arrive one of these days so look forward to it."
translation: 妈妈：“其实呢，小瞬，我给你准备了一份礼物。那份惊喜礼物就是……一位‘姐姐’！她过几天就会到，你好好期待吧。”
